items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: fold, emergency, full fold, quarantine, key/path validation, integrity check (fold and quarantine exceptions), F11 claim check; no-op without folders; CI workflow wiring deferred to the operator

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: verify-before-delete, recheck under the lock, conflicting ids refuse (exit 1), git trouble exits 2, interrupted fold resumable (tested)

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: name grammar, case-variant folders, symlinks, archive injection, forged run stamps, foreign keys; files written via durable_atomic_write, no os.open modes

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: real git repos, bare-origin merge-tree race, real repo log shape, CRLF checkout, tool output judged by the checker

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: one cat-file per file (batching deferred); no-op path is a single diff

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: new modules under 300 LOC, events_read at 300 and events_log at 313 not raised

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: producer fold tool to consumer checker proven by running the tool then the checker on the commit; reader to fold race probed
